market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from oil above $102, trade war escalation, and bond volatility. PPI/CPI data and Oracle earnings will set tone. Expect 2-4% equity volatility. Gold and energy outperform; rate-sensitive sectors under pressure. Bessent's failed yield intervention creates policy uncertainty.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex supercycle (Google $15B, ASML EUV, Cisco networking) supports 12-18 month tech leadership. Iran conflict resolution timeline uncertain; oil may normalize to $85-95 by Q1 2027. Fed likely delivers one hike, not two, if growth softens. Trade war with Canada may expand but market will adapt. AI governance regulation emerges as key 2027 theme.
